name: Mask of Lethica Nightborne

source.note: Fabled Heirloom from Memory's Rest; the book's numbers, our words.

summary: A Fabled Heirloom, the High Priestess: a porcelain mask with violet filigree. +1 to Wisdom and Charisma saves (+2 at level 7, +3 at 13); its wearer sees through magical Darkness and casts Darkness twice a dusk (four from level 7), and in that Darkness the wearer and its allies resist Psychic damage. From level 7, Balm of Midnight: at the start of the wearer's turn a Frightened ally within 60 ft gets a DC 15 Wisdom save to shake it off, and 2d10 Temporary Hit Points in the dark.
